inlines.v: SEG'REGATE, v. t. [Latin segrego; se, from, and grex, flock.] To separate from others; to set apart. SEG'REGATE, adjective. Select. [Little used.] Segregate polygamy, (Polygamia segregata, Linne, ) a mode of inflorescence, when several florets comprehended within a common calyx, are furnished also with their proper perianths. Martyn.
